articleTitle: Parameter Optimization of Spark in Heterogeneous Environment Based on Hyperband
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: There are many default parameters in Spark, which have a great influence on job performance. Different jobs require different parameter combos, resulting in the need to tune parameters with experience which causes low efficiency. To improve the performance of Spark in the heterogeneous environment, the Hyperband algorithm is used to optimize the Spark parameters to improve the efficiency of the Spark platform. To emulate the actual production environment and improve operation efficiency as possible, this study uses Spark on yarn mode to test. Experiments are carried out on WordCount and Sort job types. The results show that, taking 5GB dataset as an example, compared with the default parameters., this method reduces the job execution time by 12.94% and 10.41%, respectively.

articleTitle: Optimizations of Training Dataset on House Price Estimation
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: House price in many cases can strongly reflect local economy, predicting the real estate price can help consumer and the developers. In this way, consumers can inquiry price by giving a series of attributes which describes their ideal house and sellers can get the recommended price by uploading the property description. Thus, a fast, 24-hour responsive auto-inquiry system can greatly improve customers' and sellers' experience. To establish similar system, the dataset which is used to describe the sale of individual residential property in Ames is set as an experiment material. This paper discusses the influence from the data-preprocessing stage on the establishment of later machine learning model using different data groups. Later in the accuracy comparison, controlled experiment is implemented to show the accuracy among different organization of the algorithms. This paper is aimed at how much influence from the model choosing and data preprocessing stage will be made on the prediction accuracy and interpret methods used in preprocessing stage. Furthermore, the experiments show that the single model prediction's accuracy has on average 5% less than the stacked model. In addition, the results represented in this paper have the potential to be integrated into the housing sales system which can be applied to price delivery systems to benefit both consumers and sellers.

articleTitle: The Determinants of Carbon Emission Price—Empirical Analysis Based on the VEC Model
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Recent years, a carbon emission trading system has emerged as an effective measure to reduce greenhouse gas emissions. Thus it is of significance to figure out the determinants of carbon emission price. Based on time series data, the VEC model was constructed to investigate the determinants of carbon emission determinants. The result suggested that there exists a cointegration relationship between carbon emission futures price, Euro Stoxx 50 index and crude oil price. It is pointed out that carbon emission futures price increases as Euro Stoxx 50 index rises and crude oil price decreases in the long run equilibrium. Also when the short run fluctuation deviates from the long run equilibrium, the error adjusts at a relatively low velocity of -0.0087.

articleTitle: Design of two-stage federal learning incentive mechanism under specific indicators
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: As a privacy-focused distributed machine learning, federated learning can not only train models effectively but also prevent data sets from being leaked easily. However, like crowdsensing perception and other technologies, participants often lack the motivation to learn and the quality of participation is not high. Therefore, this paper mainly designs a two-stage federal learning incentive mechanism based on the Stackelberg game model under a specific model accuracy index. Firstly, we combine data quality and data quantity to construct a federal learning incentive mechanism model under specific indicators. Then, we conduct a two-stage Stackelberg game analysis on the incentive mechanism model based on the utility function construction of the server platform and data island. In the first stage, the platform server is the leader and the data island is the follower. The second stage is a Nash equilibrium game between data islands. Finally, we construct the objective function of the server platform and data island, namely utility maximization, deduce the optimal equilibrium solution of the two-stage game, and determine the optimal strategy of the platform server and data island.

articleTitle: Research on China's Digital Village Construction and Development Path under the Big Data Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: The implementation of the rural revitalization strategy is inseparable from the construction of digital villages. The advent of the era of big data has provided a new path to the construction of China's digital countryside, and it has also provided a new method of improving the level of digital management of rural information. This article analyzes the current situation and basic logical structure of China's digital village construction. In view of the current weak construction of rural digital infrastructure in China, the existence of “information islands” in data integration and sharing, the shortage of rural digital talent resources, and the need to improve the digital literacy of rural populations, the author believes that it is possible to optimize the construction of rural information infrastructure and increase digital talents. Cultivating and introducing efforts, constructing a data sharing platform with collaborative participation in multiple subjects, and improving the digital literacy of the rural population are improved to maximize the power of big data. Hope to provide some experience in China to promote the rural revitalization strategy.

articleTitle: Development trend forecast and investment prospect analysis of BIPV: Analysis of stock data based on 36 BIPV Companies in Shanghai and Shenzhen stock markets
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: BIPV is a technology that integrates solar power (photovoltaic) products into buildings. Because of its advantages of environmental protection, high efficiency and economy, it is one of the key measures to solve the problem of energy consumption in buildings in the future and has a broad market and investment prospect. This paper uses a combination of moving average, trend equation fitting method, Pearson correlation coefficient, Lyapunov exponent, and data processing software such as Matlab and Python to make the BIPV sector based on the stock data of 36 BIPV-related companies in the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock markets moving average and SSE index trend chart from April 1, 2019, to May 28, 2021, and analyze the correlation between the SSE index and the sector index to predict the future development trend of the BIPV sector. The article also assesses the investment risks of 36 individual stocks. Finally, recommendations are given to investors based on investment prospects and investment risks.

articleTitle: Research on the Exploration and Reflection of Foreign Language Teaching Based on “Artificial Intelligence + Education” in the Big Data Era
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: In the Big Data era, Artificial Intelligence (AI) has the potential to address some of the biggest challenges in education filed today, innovate teaching and learning practices, and thus accelerate the progress to digital education. Traditional foreign language teaching focuses more on traditional teaching methods, for instance, Grammar Translation, Direct Method in the classroom; however, with the emergence of artificial intelligence in education, innovative teaching and learning such as mobile learning occur, which allows teaching and learning take place outside the classroom. This paper aims to investigate the application of AI into foreign language teaching, which takes College English Teaching as an example. The development of AI in education, mobile learning, big data, blended learning, flipped classrooms, and smart learning platforms is introduced as literature review, and then the design and application of AI into FLT, to be specific, College English Teaching is outlined to illustrate the implementation of AI in education.

articleTitle: The Technological Innovation, the Industrial Structure Upgrading and the Total Factor Productivity
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: This paper constructs a panel regression model based on the data of 30 provinces in China (excluding Tibet) from 2011 to 2019, and gradually adds control variables for regression. Finally, we use the robustness test of replacing the core explanatory variables to verify the impact of the technological innovation on the total factor productivity. The results show that the technological innovation significantly improves the total factor productivity. This paper also uses the mediating effect model. Stepwise regression analysis is used to test the relationship between the technological innovation and the total factor productivity in the industrial structure upgrading. The results show that the technological innovation significantly promotes the total factor productivity through the intermediary of the industrial structure upgrading. Finally, this paper puts forward some policy recommendations, such as increasing the R&D investment and accelerating the industrial transformation and upgrading.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis on Chinese Movie Comment with LDA Model
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Film has become one of the main means for modern people to relax their life, and it is also an important measure of consumer economic growth. With the continuous decline of the global movie industry, only by understanding the current development of Chinese movies and exploring the actual viewing needs of the audience can we effectively promote the development of the movie industry. This paper crawls to the specific information and reviews of popular movies, through data visualization and LDA theme analysis model, gets the general development trend of movies and audience preferences. The results show that China currently occupies most of the world movie market, but all movie practitioners still need to work hard on the reality of the movie story and create high-quality movies that meet the needs of the audience.

articleTitle: Analysis of Operations of Poultry Farm Using IoT Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: In the contemporary world mechanization accepts an essential part. This representation focuses on the computerization of poultry farms by utilising a far off sensor climate and versatile correspondence structure. Chicken is the most adored food thing delivered for utilization and it is an enhancement rich food giving high protein, low fat, and low cholesterol than various poultries. In this representation normal boundaries of a poultry ranch like temperature, gas, and fire are noticed and controlled thus to grow the improvement of chicken. The water level is furthermore controlled and checked with the support of the sensor module. By interfacing all the sensor devices to the mcu all sensor regards are placed then utilising the wifi device it will be moved to the thingspeak cloud server.

articleTitle: Analysis of the impact of digital economy on industrial structure upgrading based on stata
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: With the rise of the Internet and the rapid development of network technology, data has gradually become a resource for social development. We are moving towards the era of ‘ data is productivity ‘. With the development of big data, digital economy is a new driving force for improving the quality and efficiency of China's economic development and a new engine for upgrading the industrial structure. This paper uses stata based on fixed effect benchmark model to conduct regression analysis on China's provincial panel data from 2013 to 2019, and empirically examines the impact of digital economy on industrial structure upgrading. The results show that the development of digital economy can significantly promote the upgrading of industrial structure, which is manifested in the central > western > eastern regions. This paper clarifies the impact of digital economy on the upgrading of industrial structure, which is of great significance to the transformation and upgrading of industrial structure and the establishment of modern industrial system.

articleTitle: Research on accurate data analysis of power grid digital investment based on fuzzy decision tree: The SG-BDC Accurate Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: With the improvement of information technology level, power generation groups and other group power enterprises pay more and more attention to the unified formulation of digital development plans, and are committed to realizing the integration, sharing and collaboration of digitization within the whole group. The overall pattern of. Focusing on refining the management of power grid digital investment before, during and after the event, this paper proposes a strategy to improve the accuracy of power grid digital investment based on fuzzy decision tree, and carries out research through accurate data analysis to effectively improve the efficiency of power grid digital investment and the sustainable development ability of enterprises, so as to maintain and increase the value of state-owned assets

articleTitle: Energy big data automatic desensitization model based on Spark parallel computing framework
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: With the vigorous development of the electric power industry, the large amount of data generated has also brought tremendous pressure to information security. Data desensitization model is limited by the computing efficiency and memory capacity of a single computing node, which is difficult to meet the desensitization needs of massive data. Based on Spark parallel computing framework, an automatic desensitization model of energy big data is proposed. Depending on the regular dependence between data sets, the elastic distributed data set is established, and the big data parallel processing framework is established by using Spark framework, which decomposes the single node processing task into multi node data blocks. The distributed anonymization algorithm is designed to divide the buffer tuple to complete the anonymization before desensitization. The reserved number of generalized nodes is determined, and a distributed desensitization model based on cooperative computing of multiple computing nodes is established. The experimental results show that the privacy protection strength of this model is 0.0763 and 0.1007 higher than that of the data desensitization model based on centralized anonymization algorithm and regular specific format when the data set size reaches the maximum of 60G. Therefore, the designed model has good data desensitization ability, and can ensure the privacy of data under the condition of large amount of data.

articleTitle: Promote Internet Economic Development and Smart City Construction with Data Sharing
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Internet economy is a new economic form based on the Internet, with information technology as the core, a smart city is the use of a new generation of information technology, in order to achieve urban management services, enterprise survival development, and residents' production lifestyle intelligence, further enhance the core competitiveness of urban development, can provide residents with a high-quality life. Taking China as an example, this paper puts forward the path of smart city development according to the current situation of the smart city construction: use Internet technology to build public big data, strengthen the construction of digital infrastructure projects, fully mine data, lay a good technical foundation for the construction of the smart city, integrate urban development with the Internet, and gradually promote harmonious development of the city.

articleTitle: Prediction of Coupon Usage Behavior Based on Customer Segmentation and XGBoost algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Coupons are an important means for merchants to promote sales. It is necessary to separately perform precision marketing on different types of customers and distribute coupons to customers who are more likely to consume. Therefore, a prediction model of coupon usage behavior based on customer segmentation was constructed in this paper. First, the sensitivity information customer makes on coupons was introduced into the RFM model to propose the improved RFM model, namely the RFS model. Moreover, combined with the K-means algorithm, the RFS model was divided into different categories according to customer value. Then, the XGBoost algorithm was applied to the full data and each category of customers to predict the write-off situation after receiving the coupon. Finally, actual cases were applied to predicting the use of coupons, which were compared with GBDT and LighGBM algorithms. The results showed that the prediction effect of the model proposed in this paper was higher than that of full data and other machine learning algorithms, which provided a reference for the accurate delivery of coupons in real applications.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Scientific Research Competitiveness in Eastern Coastal Provinces and Cities Based on Grey Correlation Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Research competitiveness of colleges and universities is one of the important standards to measure the level and research strength of universities. Based on the grey correlation comprehensive evaluation method, the scientific research competitiveness of universities in eastern coastal provinces and cities is evaluated. The results show that: universities in eastern coastal provinces and cities In terms of scientific research competitiveness, the scientific research competitiveness of institutions of higher learning in Jiangsu Province is the strongest in the eastern coastal provinces and cities, and is far higher than that of Shanghai, which ranks second. Hainan Province has the worst scientific research competitiveness of institutions of higher learning. By analyzing the reasons for the large differences in scientific research competitiveness of the eastern coastal provinces, and putting forward suggestions: each province should comprehensively implement policies to enhance scientific research competitiveness, the government should increase support for scientific research work in universities and increase scientific research funding; universities should make full use of various Fund support, increase the utilization rate of funds, create a sound scientific research policy, integrate advantageous resources, reform the talent introduction system, and create conditions to attract and retain young innovative talents to participate in scientific research.

articleTitle: Customer Review Elements of Agricultural Products E-commerce and Their Influence on Satisfaction Based on Big Data Crawlers
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: In recent years, the government has paid more and more attention to agricultural and rural informatization, and the e-commerce of agricultural products has developed rapidly. In order to help agricultural product e-commerce companies identify the key elements that customers pay attention to when purchasing agricultural products online, so as to focus on each element and improve customer satisfaction, this study uses the “octopus collector” to collect comment data of Tmall and Taobao agricultural products with a total of 25,798 comments. Uses grounded theory to code some of these comments, and extract the true evaluations of some users of Taobao and Tmall agricultural products. Evaluation elements and draw a structural diagram of user online evaluation elements. After three-level quantitative coding of elements, SPSS 22.0 multiple linear regression is used to determine the effect of review elements on overall user satisfaction.

articleTitle: A Risk Management Model for Power Industry based on Impact Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Critical information infrastructure is an important strategic asset of the country, and risk management research is a hot direction. Inspired by the risk management framework (RMF) proposed by the United States, we have proposed a risk management model based on impact analysis to evaluate security controls for critical infrastructure in the power industry. This model defines the fundamental elements such as stakeholders, system components, attack types, and generates the dependency matrix and impact matrix between them. Through impact analysis and matrix calculation, we can obtain the risks and costs due to the lack of security with the initial data constructed by experience. In the end, we summarize vulnerable components, and provide power operators with infrastructure reinforcement recommendations to improve their security capabilities.

articleTitle: Analysis of the performance and subsidy trend of pure electric vehicles in China based on big data research
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Based on big data research, this paper analyzes the performance and subsidy standards of pure electric vehicles in China. The results show that the ownership of pure electric vehicles and other types of vehicles in China is increasing at a rate of 4.48 times and 4.11 times respectively. In addition, the ownership of pure electric vehicles accounts for 81.3% of the total number of new energy vehicles. The cruising mileage and battery energy of pure electric vehicles increased by 2.39 and 1.64 times respectively.

articleTitle: The Application of Big Data Technology in Computer Network Information Management
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Nowadays, big data technology has been frequently used in computer network information management. Big data technology can make computer network information management more convenient and improve the quality and technical level of information management. At the same time, big data technology can also analyze and organize large and complex data, making information resource sharing more real and accurate. This article focuses on the authority module in the computer network information management, and divides the authority level according to the needs of users, which can realize the field-level access control in the database, thereby improving the information protection of the computer network information management. The correct use of big data in the authority management module can also improve the security of network information management.

articleTitle: Research on the Impact of Big Data Application on Technological Innovation of Chinese new Energy Vehicle Industry
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Big data, as an important way to promote the development of the real economy, has gradually increased its positive influence on the technological innovation of new energy automobile companies. By analyzing the relevant data of my country from 2015 to 2020, it is found that the development of big data has a clear positive relationship with the new energy vehicle technology innovation index. For every 1% increase in the big data development index, the technology innovation index of new energy vehicle companies will increase by 2.895%. The policy recommendations derived from the research results of this article are: First, it is useful to promote the development of big data technology and build a big data technology power. Second, it is helpful constructing a way to integrate big data technology with the new energy automobile industry together. Third, it is helpful to establish a national comprehensive inspection and management platform.

Author Keywords: technological innovation of new energy vehicle enterprises

articleTitle: A Fair Incentive Mechanism in Federated Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Federated learning (FL) has shown great potential for addressing the challenge of isolated data islands while preserving data privacy. However, not everyone is willing to participate in federated learning to share their data computation results. Providing incentives is a common way to promote the success of federated learning. The design of this paper focuses on the incentive mechanism based on the reverse auction. First, an incentive model for crowdsourcing systems is constructed. Secondly, an auction-based incentive mechanism is proposed by combining the concepts of reverse auction and VCG auction. Simulation results indicate that the proposed incentive mechanism can effectively improve the fairness of the bids. In this paper, we present a VCG-based FL incentive mechanism, named LVCG, specifically designed for incentivizing data owners to contribute all their data and truthfully report their costs in FL settings.

articleTitle: Research on coevolution of leisure agriculture supply chain with information sharing and incentive alliance as order parameters
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: According to the synergy theory, taking information sharing and incentive alliance as the system order parameters, the coevolution model of leisure agricultural supply chain is established. Taking the generalized Langevin equation as the main research tool, the coevolution process of leisure agricultural supply chain is revealed by solving the equation and combining with the potential functions curve. It is concluded that when the influence of control parameters on order parameters is greater than the damping factor, under the action of random fluctuation, leisure agriculture supply chain can realize information sharing and incentive alliance to achieve collaborative stability.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Impact of COVID-19 on the U.S. Economy Based on Big Data Processing and Experimental Analyses
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: With the outbreak of COVID-19, the world has experienced unprecedented crises especially in economy. The United States is more seriously affected. In order to more clearly show the current situation of the U.S. economy affected by the epidemic from the data level, the author completes the paper by using the research method of big data processing and experimental analyses to show that how Coronavirus influences economy, that is, the impact on GDP and the exchange of volume of stock shares and the impact on unemployment rate which can be shown in specific data. The author also discusses the degree of influence on different industries. The result shows that COVID-19 has seriously affected the overall economy of America. The specific data performance is the decline of GDP (about 5%) and the rise of unemployment (about 15%). The stock price has dropped significantly, even affecting the overall stock trading volume (declined by 55%). The purpose of this paper is to clearly show the specific influence on the US economy from the data level. The result can provide a specific data reference for the formulation of American economic policy in the next few years and provide a data basis for the study of the economic situation after the epidemic in the United States.

articleTitle: Research on Construction and Optimization of Smart Community in China
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: This study was based on the intelligence construction of Harbin S District as a research object, using a Grounded Theory research method, analyzing qualitative data, and constructing a process framework model for smart community construction. Studies have found that smart community construction includes technology, social and organizational coordination and interaction; there is a game behavior in the construction process; key actors with street offices can achieve smart community construction actors to mobilize and form a series of ways Relatively stable actors’ interest networks and build a constituent interest community, and cooperate to promote the construction of smart communities. Studies can provide possible analytical ideas for smart community construction.

articleTitle: Research on Business Model of Internet of Vehicles Platform Based on Token Economy
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: With the increasing number of electric vehicles, the scale of the market also increases. In the past, the electric vehicle market had problems such as opaque information, numerous levels and data leakage, which were criticized for the impact of the overall development and policies of the electric vehicle industry. In view of the problems existing in the transparency and security of big data management transactions of the Internet of vehicles, this paper combs the commercial operation framework of the Internet of Vehicles Platform, analyses the feasibility and necessity of establishing the token system of the Internet of Vehicles Platform, and constructs the token economic system architecture of the Internet of Vehicles Platform and its development path.

articleTitle: Evaluation Model of Leadership Competency Based on Fuzzy Information and Its Algorithm Implementation
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Competency model is widely used in enterprises, and effective evaluation of leadership competency is the basis and prerequisite for their selection, training, performance management and personal development. Based on a systematic review of relevant literatures, this study proposed a leadership competency evaluation model based on fuzzy information, and designed a solution algorithm. Taking the leadership competency evaluation of A company as a case, this study carried out the identification of individual advantage characteristics of leadership competency, and performed its individual agent evaluation and democratic agent evaluation. The results show that the algorithm can effectively identify the advantage characteristics of leaders. It also helps to explore the inherent strength structure of leadership competency and provides technical methods for individual growth and improvement.

articleTitle: Research on the Relationship Between Enterprise Internal Control and Cross-Border Mergers and Acquisitions Performance in the Internet Era-Using the Multiple Linear Regression Model and Statistical Softwares
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Nowadays, Cross-border mergers and acquisitions (M&A) have been a significant way for Chinese companies to enter the international market. As a system for enterprises to control business risks, internal control has a fundamental role in the business activities. What is more, the essence of cross-border M&A is high-risk projects. Therefore, the question is raised about if internal control can be helpful in promoting the performance of cross-border M&A. This study combs the relevant domestic and foreign literature, and takes the cross-border M&A activities of Chinese listed companies as the main merging party from 2013 to 2017 as the initial research object, establishes a multiple linear regression model, and uses statistical softwares such as SPSS 26.0, Stata 16.0 and Excel 2013 to complete data processing and empirical analysis, and finds out that internal control affects positively on the improvement of cross-border M&A performance. Effective internal control has a very positive role in improving the performance of cross-border M&A in companies with higher financing constraints in comparison with companies with lower financing constraints. Accordingly, this paper also puts forward relevant suggestions to enterprises, aiming to promote the improvement of the performance of enterprises’ cross-border M&A.

articleTitle: Research on customer loyalty of virtual brand community based on structural equation model
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: With the popularity of the Internet, virtual brand community has become an important platform for enterprises to communicate with customers. This paper constructs a customer loyalty measurement model including four dimensions: member interaction, community maintenance, community identity and community brand fit. Based on the sample survey data of 301 virtual brand community members, spss25.0 and amos24.0 software are used to analyze and verify the impact and mechanism of various dimensional variables on customer loyalty. The results show that member interaction, community maintenance and community identity can enhance customers' loyalty to the brand, and the order of influence is community maintenance, member interaction and community identity; Member interaction and community maintenance indirectly affect customer loyalty through community identity; Community brand fit positively regulates the impact of community identity on customer loyalty. Based on the above research conclusions, from the perspective of enterprises, this paper will put forward suggestions for enterprises to use virtual brand community to stabilize consumers, improve customer loyalty and increase profits.

articleTitle: Research on the Countermeasures of Regional Economic Development of Hegang City, a Coal Resource City from the Perspective of Cultural Tourism: Analysis of panel data based on stata
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Due to the exhaustion of resources and difficulties in transition, the regional development of Hegang, a coal resource-based city, is facing unprecedented challenges. However, Hegang City has developed natural resources and promising tourism industry, so it can stimulate the economy from cultural tourism and get rid of the resource dilemma. Cultural tourism is an important factor that affects regional economic development, and its development direction also affects the direction of regional economic development. The article will be based on the data of Hegang City's GDP, GDP per capita, and total cultural tourism income from 2010 to 2019, and use stata software to do a panel data analysis of Hegang City's tourism income and regional GDP. You can know through the var regression results. The regression coefficient of L.lntour is 0.6154, and the corresponding p-value is less than 0.01, indicating that cultural tourism income has a significant positive effect on the current per capita GDP growth. This article will put forward corresponding countermeasures in a targeted manner, with a view to promoting better and faster development of the regional economy.

articleTitle: Mobile Internet and Residents’ Happiness-Quantitative Analysis Based on CFPS
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Based on the data of Chinese Family Panel Studies (CFPS), the research uses ordered probit model to test whether mobile Internet is positively related with residents’ happiness. And it finds that mobile Internet has a significant positive impact on residents’ happiness. The heterogeneity analysis shows that residents in rural area or below undergraduate degree are more likely to obtain happiness from mobile Internet. And the further study denotes that mobile Internet significantly reduces the contribution of income to residents’ perception of happiness.

articleTitle: Research on the Transformation of Traditional Foreign Trade Enterprises to Cross-Border ECommerce
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: There has been increasingly widespread economic trade activities on the Internet - cross-border e-commerce with global reach, a profound commercial revolution in international trade. In 2020, COVID-19 has broken out and brought a huge impact to the global economy and a severe test to China's traditional foreign trade enterprises. However, cross-border ecommerce unleashes its huge potential, showing a leading role in the innovative development of foreign trades. Supported by advanced technologies, cross-border e-commerce has become an important driving force in the transformation and upgrading of China's traditional foreign trade enterprises, with low operating costs, high efficiency, flexible operation and high profitability. This paper analyzed the connotation and characteristics of cross-border e-commerce, and elaborated on the problems faced by Chinese traditional foreign trade enterprises in the process of transforming into cross-border e-commerce, and put forward corresponding countermeasures and suggestions for the problems faced.

articleTitle: Hotel Quality Evaluation and Promotion Strategy Based on IPA Analysis: An Empirical Case of Sofitel Hotel in Xining City
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: The quality of a hotel has a direct impact on customer satisfaction with the hotel, and determines the competitiveness and sustainable development of the hotel. This paper constructs the model of quality evaluation of hotel from five quality dimensions including service quality, hardware facilities quality, safety quality, management quality and dish quality, collects data of the quality evaluation of Sofitel Hotel in Xining by questionnaire. SPSS22.0 software was used to analyze hotel quality, Cronbach's alpha coefficient and KMO test revealed that the reliability and validity of the data are good, and four-quadrant analysis method was used to reveal the disadvantages and advantages of Sofitel hotel quality. The results show that: (1) the overall quality of the Sofitel does not reach the customer's expectations, the customer satisfaction with Sofitel's hardware quality is the highest, and the satisfaction with the management quality is the lowest. (2) In the future, the Sofitel should focus on improving management quality, strengthening the classified training of staff, improving service quality, maintaining the hotel facilities, strictly controlling the quality of safety and enhancing the customers' sense of security, updating the menu regularly, and launch their specials. This study can provide practical guidance and reference for hotels to improve their quality, market competitiveness and customer satisfaction.

articleTitle: Forecasting and Analysis of Foreign Direct Investment in Shanghai Based on Time Series Model
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Foreign direct investment is an important force for economic and social development and has a significant contribution to economic growth. Based on R programming language, this paper compares and analyzes the fitting effect of the ARIMA model and Holt-Winters model on the time-series of foreign direct investment in Shanghai from May 2013 to April 2021, and predicts the value of the foreign direct investment in the next 12 months using the better fitting model. Moreover, the cointegration relationship between container throughput and foreign direct investment in Shanghai is investigated. The conclusion shows that the Holt-Winters model is relatively good at predicting foreign direct investment, and there is a more significant cointegration relationship between container throughput and foreign direct investment.

articleTitle: Current Situation and Optimization of the Combined Development of E-Commerce and the Rural Cultural Tourism -- Based on Big Data and Data Visualization Method
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: By using the data visualization analysis method, this paper makes an in-depth analysis of the current situation of integrated development of E-commerce and rural cultural tourism industry in China, analyzes the effect of e-commerce on the rural cultural tourism industry, and clarifies the factors restricting the development of rural e-commerce tourism in China at this stage. To further promote the development of higher quality of rural e-commerce tourism industry in China, it provides reference suggestions, that is, based on the e-commerce platform, build characteristic brands of rural tourism, provide sufficient transportation, communication, and talent support, and speed up the in-depth integration development of rural tourism industry chain and rural e-commerce. In addition, this paper uses the swot analysis tool, from the strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, threats, such four dimensions, and introduces the advantages and disadvantages of e-commerce in rural cultural tourism in detail. Finally, this paper, through structure design, finds that e-commerce can help the development of rural cultural tourism.

articleTitle: Application of multiple linear regression statistical model: Executive compensation incentives, risk-taking and R&D investment
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: This article uses multiple statistical analysis methods to verify the correlation between variables through the connection of multiple linear regression equations. Through the analysis of the panel data of different types of executive compensation incentives and R&D investment in Chinese listed companies, it is found that there is a significant positive correlation between executive compensation incentives and R&D investment. Further research found that executive monetary compensation incentives and on-the-job consumption affect the R&D investment of enterprises by influencing the risk-taking ability of executives.

articleTitle: Applications of Big Data in Fighting the COVID-19 and Future Employment
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Since the coronavirus (SARS-CoV-2) outbreak in 2019, it has infected millions of people and claimed the lives of tens of thousands of people. During the coronavirus pandemic, big data and its applications have become one of the few powerful means to fight the virus. Nowadays, many countries and research institutions are using big data and its applications to track and control the spread of the contagious disease. In the future, people can use big data to fight against such epidemics. For example, comparative genomic research on virus variants, accelerated by big data analysis, can yield important information about virus mutations and evolutionary selection. This article mainly discusses the application of big data during the COVID-19 pandemic and how to fight similar epidemics in the future. Software and applications have been developed based on big data to track and predict infections. IoT -based solutions have been deployed in preliminary diagnosis. Therefore, in similar epidemics in the future, big data can accelerate tracking, prediction, diagnosis, and treatment, which helps the government and experts make more informed decisions to fight the virus and reduce its social impact.

articleTitle: Analysis On The Phenomenon of “Big Data-Enabled Price Discrimination Against Existing Customers $^{\prime\prime}$ of Internet Enterprises Based On Evolutionary Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: While big data technology brings opportunities to human society, it also hides some risks and dangers. Some Internet companies use big data technology to set different prices for different consumers, which affects consumers' trust in big data technology. This paper constructs an evolutionary game model between government regulators and Internet enterprises from the perspective of bounded, and uses MATLAB software for simulation analysis. Simulation results show that: the greater the public's sense of trust and the punishment of government regulators, the less likely the phenomenon of “big data-enabled price discrimination against existing customers”.

Author Keywords: Big data-enabled price discrimination against existing customers

articleTitle: The industrial structure upgrading and regional economic growth: an empirical analysis from China's provincial panel data
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: The core of how to break through the situation of “internal and external troubles” and realize regional economic growth in China is to promote the industrial structure upgrading. In order to empirically analyze the impact of the industrial structure upgrading on regional economic growth, based on the panel data of 30 provinces in China (excluding Tibet) from 2011 to 2020, this paper uses the empirical model to gradually add control variables for regression, and finally uses two robustness tests of tail treatment and province fixed effects. The results show that after introducing a series of relevant control variables, the industrial structure upgrading has a significant positive effect on regional economic growth. At the same time, based on the results of empirical research, this paper puts forward some policy suggestions, such as formulating regional differentiation policies, increasing long-term investment in innovative technology and human capital.

articleTitle: Analysis on the logic of digital economy development in the era of big data
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: In the era of big data, the basic role of data is becoming more and more significant: digital technology, goods and services are not only accelerating the penetration of multi-directional, multi-level and multi chain into traditional industries, that is, industrial digitization; It also promotes the continuous development and growth of digital industrial chains and industrial clusters such as Internet data center construction and services, that is, digital industrialization. It can be said that big data related technologies and applications have spawned a blue ocean for the development of digital economy, including emerging technologies such as big data, cloud computing, Internet of things, block-chain, artificial intelligence and 5g communication; At the application level, typical representatives are ‘new retail’, ‘new manufacturing’, etc. (Abstract)

articleTitle: Study on the influencing factors of grain yield in China based on multiple linear regression
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Food is the necessary goods for human survival, and it is the important material basis for national economic development and social stability. The research on grain yield is of great significance. Therefore, this paper selects grain sown area, effective irrigation area, total power of agricultural machinery, chemical fertilizer application amount, disaster area and employment number of primary industry as explanatory variables, and grain yield as explained variables, collecting the relevant data from 1986 to 2019, using Eviews 8.0 software, and build multivariate regression model to explore the relationship between grain yield and its influencing factors. The results showed that grain sown area, effective irrigation area and chemical fertilizer application were positively correlated with grain yield, while disaster area was negatively correlated with grain yield. It is suggested that the government should protect the area of cultivated land and help farmers make efficient use of land, and urge and help farmers to use chemical fertilizer scientifically and reasonably. It should strengthen the construction of disaster early warning mechanism and popularize disaster prevention knowledge for farmers, so as to improve grain production.

articleTitle: Construction of short video marketing model based on big data technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Based on large-scale database technology, use data mining system to fully explore a large amount of data information in short video. With the wide popularity of short video, the huge amount of short video information is full of all kinds of complex data and models. In short video marketing, database technology can process a large amount of information and store and manage it at the same time. Data mining technology will the complexity, diversity and potential of information in short video database, and use the integrated analysis of computer algorithm and data model to provide relevant data information, provide technical decision-making and management for short video marketing, and can accelerate the intelligent development of short video marketing. This paper systematically analyzes the marketing characteristics of short video based on big data technology, so as to deeply explore the practical role of database technology and data mining technology in short video marketing, and further provide technical support for the development and innovation of short video marketing.

articleTitle: Evaluation of GBM model performance with barrier options, Asian options and European options based on Tesla
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Geometric Brownian motion is a kind of financial model which is used in simulating stock prices with an assumption of a constant volatility. In order to evaluate the performance of the model, we price and investigate the differences between barrier options (knock-in and knock-out), Asian options, and European options based on the Tesla stock-taking from NASDAQ100. We carry out Monte-Carlo simulations 1000 times and price the options correspondingly. According to the analysis, the knock-in option is better for high volatility underlying assets like Tesla stock. These results shed light on a better understanding of option pricing with GBM model and point out its shortcomings in reality.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Big Data Platform for Municipal Social Governance
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: The effectiveness of municipal social governance is directly related to the harmony and stability of the municipal society, serving as a key part of the modernization of the national governance system and governance capabilities. The use of emerging information technologies such as big data, artificial intelligence, and blockchain to promote technological empowerment and improve the intelligence and refinement of social governance is one of the important focal points for promoting the modernization of Municipal social governance. This paper takes the construction of a centralized management platform for group rental housing in Wujin District of Changzhou City as an example to systematically study data aggregation, data sharing, application scenario innovation, and platform integration, and propose countermeasures and suggestions for Municipal social governance in the era of big data.

articleTitle: Control and Simulation of a Stochastic Financial System
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: In this paper we established a random financial chaotic system. Firstly, we discussed the exponential attractive set, boundedness, and asymptotic stability conditions of the stochastic financial system. Subsequently, the stochastic sensitivity function technology (SSF) is used to describe the probability distribution of the random bundle formed near the exponential stable equilibrium point, and the sensitivity analysis of the stochastic financial system is carried out. We designed a feedback controller by constructing stochastic sensitivity matrix to suppress stochastic oscillation and control chaos. Finally, the software Mathematica was used for numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Multi criteria recommendation method of cross-border e-commerce shopping guide platform based on big data
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: The fit between recommended goods and user preferences determines the trading volume of cross-border e-commerce shopping guide platform. Therefore, a multi criteria recommendation method of cross-border e-commerce shopping guide platform based on big data is proposed. The user behavior is divided into three stages, Web page click, shopping cart placement and online purchase. By weighting, the user's consumption preference is obtained. The association rules of goods are mined from the two aspects of confidence and support, and then the collaborative filtering recommendation is realized based on the principles of users and goods. The test results show that the accuracy, recall and coverage of the design method are better than the comparison method and has a good recommendation effect.

articleTitle: Exploration on the Influence Factors of Internet-Based Tourism Information Dissemination on the Evolution of Tourism Destinations
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: This article analyzes the life cycle theory of tourism destinations, and combines the influence factors of tourism information dissemination on the evolution of tourism destinations. The content includes the promotion of film and television dramas, the dissemination of photographic works, online communication, official organization promotion, celebrity effects, and cultural attraction. Through studying the shortcomings of Internet-based tourism information dissemination, it puts forward corresponding measures, with the aim of making rational use of the advantages of tourism information dissemination and promoting the healthy development of tourism economy in tourism destinations.

articleTitle: Research on digital information management of government archives under the background of big data
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: In the context of big data, the development of any industry is inseparable from the application of digital informatization. The development of governmrnt archives is inseparable from digital construction. Relying on OCR technology, the text items of governmrnt archives can be automatically input by computer to accelerate the process of digital transformation. In view of the four problems faced by the office archives work in the process of digital transformation: unclear understanding of the concept of digital transformation, imperfect management system, relatively weak digital infrastructure construction and no refinement of digital management standards, the office units can cultivate data thinking, improve the system system, build a digital platform, optimize infrastructure construction and refine standard cultivation “Digitization + archives management” talents should be improved in these four aspects, so as to provide reference for coping with the background of big data era and accelerating the digital transformation of governmrnt archives management.

articleTitle: The Influence Path of User Brand Cognition on User Loyalty Under the Background of Big Data Marketing: An Empirical Analysis Based on FsQCA
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: In the era of the digital economy, big data marketing has gradually become a mainstream marketing method. However, more studies have analyzed big data marketing from the perspective of enterprises, ignoring the impact of big data marketing on users. Taking big data marketing as the research background, this paper selects three important factors in the process of brand cognition: brand familiarity, brand satisfaction, and brand community influence, builds the action path of brand cognition affecting user loyalty, and adopts fsQCA to identify four specific paths. The research result is the improvement of the research on the mechanism of brand cognition, which is also helpful for enterprises to improve the big data marketing strategy in practice.

articleTitle: Application Technology of Smart Water Information —Taking Kunming City as an Example
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Smart water affairs is an important part of my country's smart city construction, and it is also a key development industry in my country's strategic level. Information technology has led to fundamental changes in the construction of water affairs informatization. Starting from the national big data development strategy, this article combines the status quo of smart city construction in Kunming, and investigates the main problems existing in the process of water informatization, and conducts research on the new generation of big data, cloud computing, and Internet of Things information technology, in-depth exploration and extensive use Water affairs information resources, the establishment of an integrated perception system of the sky and the ground, and the introduction of “water affairs brain” and “integrated brain” analysis technology, with “big perception”, “big network” and “big data” as the core, building water affairs information perception comprehensive and IT The foundation supports a safe, reliable, smart and effective smart water system for business applications, which will help comprehensively improve water management capabilities and promote the rapid, healthy and orderly development of smart water.

articleTitle: A Study on the Correlation between Financial Status of Listed Companies and Chinese Stock Market: Base on Multiple linear regression analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: The stock market serves as a barometer of economic conditions. The intrinsic value of stocks can be realized through stock transaction prices, which reflect the current supply and demand of social funds, industry prospects, and changes in political forms. It is a forecast and analysis of the macroeconomic and microeconomics Important indicators. For a long time, many domestic and foreign scholars have conducted a large number of empirical studies on the correlation between the financial status of listed companies and the stock market, and have obtained quite a lot of theoretical and practical research results. This paper analyzes the stock price index and financial status information of 200 normal a-share listed companies in the last five years and studies the financial indicators and the correlation between them through the Pearson correlation coefficient. At the same time, we use Stata16.0 to establish a multiple linear regression model to test and analyze the related financial indicators based on the data of the quarterly financial reports of 200 listed companies in Shanghai and the average stock price. The results show that earnings per share, undistributed profit per share, return on total assets and other indicators are most correlated with stock prices.

articleTitle: Intelligent Analysis of Accounting Information Processing Under the Background of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: With the advent of the era of big data, the development of various industries has been profoundly affected, and corporate accounting information processing is a typical example. Based on this, this article simply analyzes the value of intelligent accounting information processing, and deeply explores the path to intelligent accounting information processing in the context of big data. Specifically, it involves the structure of the intelligent accounting information processing system, the intelligent accounting system, the intelligent decision support system, and the network interconnection system for the reference of the industry.

articleTitle: Analysis and Statistics on Patent Information of Colleges and Universities based on PatSnap: Take Wuhan University of Technology as an Example
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Take “PatSnap Patent Search and Analysis System” as the analytical tool to study patent data (2000–2020) of Wuhan University of Technology, make analysis on different respects including patent application trend, patent legal status, and patent technical field, sum up and research Wuhan University of Technology's current patent development status and characteristics, in order to provide basis and reference for Wuhan University of Technology to make IPR-related strategies in the future.

articleTitle: Research on Big Data Technology to Reduce the Cost of Community Group Buying Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: In the era of big data, applying big data technology to the community group buying platform can provide a brand new data information processing model for the community group buying supply chain and effectively manage the supply chain costs. This article analyzes and explores the current community group buying supply chain model, and uses data analysis theory to find out the shortcomings of the current model. From the perspective of big data analysis and mining, this article uses big data technology to analyze users' evaluation, products' quality feedback, and warehousing distribution to provide solutions for the improvement of supply chain models, and help community group buying companies to better manage costs.

articleTitle: The Connection between Education Input and Economic Growth―An Empirical Analysis Based on Eastern, Central and Western Cities
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: This paper applies the mathematical model research method, based on the Cobb-Douglas production function model, and selects 18 samples from the east, middle and west to study and analyze the relationship between education input and economic development. This study starts with the total investment in education and is divided into three aspects according to its source: financial education funds, private education funds and other non-financial education funds. At the same time, the employment population and physical capital are introduced to analyze the factors affecting economic growth more comprehends. By analyzing the statistical results, the following conclusions are finally obtained: on the one hand, the economy of each region will be positively promoted by the financial education funds, and the higher the economic level of a region is, the weaker the region is affected by the financial education funds; private education funds generally have no significant impact on the economy of a region; while other non-financial education funds have a positive effect on areas with high economic levels. On the other hand, for the western region where the economy is backward, there is a greater demand for both physical capital and fiscal education funds; while the eastern and western regions provide a large number of jobs due to developed industries and services. There is a certain demand for the labor force. At the end of the article, based on the above analysis, some suggestions were provided to the central and local governments.

articleTitle: The Study on Stock Selection Based on Deep Learning and the Billboard Data
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: The Billboard is a collection of active stocks in the Chinese stock market. It provides investors with a range of stocks to select from and shortens the time that the investors use to research the stocks. When stocks appear on the Billboard, they may generate positive or negative returns in the future. Therefore, it is an important topic to study how to select stocks from the Billboard which would generate positive returns in the future. In this paper, a hybrid model based on deep learning is proposed to select stocks from the Billboard. This model consists of three submodels for price prediction and movement prediction of stocks, and finally stock selection will be made based on the output of these three models. The empirical study shows that the model constructed in this paper can effectively make stock selection and achieve positive returns.

articleTitle: Study on the Dynamic Impact of Digital Inclusive Finance on Rural Revitalization — based on systematic GMM and threshold effect test
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Through GMM model method and threshold model method, study the influence of rural revitalization index and digital inclusive financial financial development level, can verify whether the linear relationship between digital inclusive financial and rural revitalization level, and the specific use of threshold model method can verify whether digital inclusive financial has a positive effect on the level of rural revitalization level. The research results show that the lower the digital inclusive financial index, the weaker the impact of digital inclusive finance on the level of rural revitalization and development, while the higher the digital inclusive financial index, the stronger the impact of digital inclusive finance on the level of rural revitalization and development. The research results also show that the results of rural revitalization and development have a certain causal relationship with the implementation of digital inclusive finance.

articleTitle: An Empirical Analysis of the Effect of Chinese Enterprises' Internationalization on Performance: Taking Listed Companies as an Example
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: As Chinese “Going out” and “Belt and Road” proposals along with the further development of reform and opening up, more and more Chinese enterprises are joining in the wave of globalization. They hope to find new profit growth points and expand diversified businesses through international development. However, there are many problems and challenges in the international of Chinese enterprises. What is the impact of enterprises' internationalization on performance? In order to test it, we select 621 Chinese manufacturing listed companies, uses state software for model building and data analysis. The result shows that there is a U -shaped relationship between enterprises' internationalization and performance, which means that we should take a long-term strategic view on the internationalization development of Chinese enterprises.

articleTitle: Research on Economic Development Level of 31 Provinces in China Based on Factor Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Through the understanding of the economic development characteristics of each province and city, combined with the specific situation of each region and the availability of data, to construct an appropriate index system that affects the level of economic development and explore the economic development level of 31 provinces and cities in China in 2019. The conclusion is that there are apparent differences in the level of economic growth between China's east and west and north and south, coastal and inland areas in 2019. It also gives policy suggestions for analyzing concrete problems, allocating resources rationally, and perfecting policies and regulations.

articleTitle: Research on China's Domestic Mobile Phone Export Trade Issues Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: In the context of economic globalization and big data, electronic products in China's export trade products in 2020 have developed relatively well, for electronic products, mobile phones are undoubtedly the most representative of electronic products. At present, the main problems in the export trade of domestic mobile phones include: lack of product core technology, resulting in it not being dominant in overseas markets; Sino-U.S. trade war and fierce market competition, leading to rising costs of domestic mobile phones; domestic mobile phone products model tends to be homogeneous, making the level and image of domestic mobile phones not clear enough; the overseas sales channels of domestic mobile phones are relatively limited, which has led to the accumulation of domestic mobile phones in the overseas market, leading to excessive market competition. In order to promote the development of domestic mobile phone export trade, domestic mobile phone companies should strengthen independent technology research and development; Companies should make reasonable use of export policies to reduce export costs; companies should innovate product features to enable domestic mobile phones to have sufficient differentiation in overseas markets; Companies should establish multi-dimensional sales channels in overseas markets. At the same time, companies should strengthen the brand building and strive to be trusted by overseas consumers.

articleTitle: Has the development of cross-border e-commerce promoted the transformation and upgrading of the G20 export trade?: Based on the empirical analysis of the adjustment effect of the export trade diversification
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: The rapid development of Internet technology has given birth to a series of e-commerce platforms, and e-commerce platforms that integrate big data and the Internet of Things have brought disruptive changes to traditional international trade. In the era of economic globalization, the role of cross-border e-commerce (hereinafter referred to as C _ EC) in international trade is becoming more and more important, and it is also a new driving force for the transformation and upgrading of foreign trade and economic development of the G20 countries. Based on the analysis of the G20 C _ EC and export trade development status, this paper constructs a measurement model of the relationship between the development of C _ EC and the transition of export trade. Using the G20 panel data from 2000 to 2019 to calculate the technical complexity of export trade, we use SPSSAU software to perform regression analysis and test the moderating effect model, the empirical study explores the impact of the development of C _ EC on the transformation and upgrading of export trade. The results show that the development of C _ EC can not only significantly facilitate the transformation and upgrading of export trade, but also significantly enhance its boosting role under the adjustment of the export trade diversification index.

articleTitle: Based on Big Data: The Analysis of Asian Options Compared With European Options in Chinese Market
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Although Asian options possess the advantages of being cheaper and more stable than European options, the Chinese financial market rarely contains any type of Asian options. Hence, this research aims to evaluate the performance of Asian options and investigate the prospect of applying the options market in China. The Monte Carlo simulations and sensitivity tests are carried out for Asian and European options pricing by the Black-Scholes model based on three different underlying assets: SH600251, DCE A, and DCE J. According to the simulations, the premium of Asian options is lower than the premium of European options. Moreover, the sensitivity test demonstrates that Asian options seem to be less sensitive to the option price because the return is determined by the average price of a set of underlying prices over a preset period. Therefore, Asian options have good development prospects in China, despite the premium of Asian options is slower to respond to changes in the underlying assets. These results offer a guideline for the implementation of Asian options in Chinese markets.

articleTitle: Research on the Impact of External Economic Policy Uncertainty on China's Financial Market and Risk Contagion
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: In the context of external economic policy uncertainty, using China's macroeconomic data from August 2014 to August 2021, using the MS-VAR model to analyze how external uncertainties impact the systemic risks of China's financial market through short-term capital flow channels Accumulation and diffusion have an impact. The results show that rising global economic policy uncertainty will trigger a procyclical effect between RMB appreciation expectations and short-term capital flows, and ultimately lead to an increase in the linkage between domestic stock prices and real estate price fluctuations, indicating that global economic policy uncertainty is triggered an important external cause of systemic financial risks in the domestic financial market. Therefore, regulators must pay close attention to the impact of global economic policy uncertainties on short-term capital flows, positively guide RMB exchange rate expectations, and minimize the effect of external shocks on the accumulation of domestic systemic financial risks.

articleTitle: Innovation and Upgrading of Agricultural Industrial Chain by Virtual Industrial Cluster Construction based on Web technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: The agricultural virtual industrial cluster platform based on Web technology and database technology is a virtual resource sharing pool of agricultural industrial chain under the mode of “Internet+agriculture” according to four dimensions: strategy making, information sharing, production and marketing cooperation and innovation and development. The agricultural virtual industrial cluster platform is a new type of agricultural development information platform based on Internet technology and composed of diversified subjects, covering the whole agricultural industrial chain. It provides a factual basis for the innovation and upgrading of the agricultural industrial chain under the current modern agricultural background, and effectively promotes the comprehensive competitiveness of China's agricultural industry.

articleTitle: License Plate Recognition Algorithm and MATLAB Implementation Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: In this paper, BP neural network is used to identify the license plate. First, we preprocess, accurately locate, character segmentation and normalize the license plate image, and then send it to BP neural network for identification. The experimental results show that the algorithm has high recognition accuracy, and has certain recognition ability for noise pollution, insufficient light, fading of background color and blurred images.

articleTitle: Research on Price Elasticity of Mobile Phone Sales on Taobao Based on Logarithmic Function Model
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: As people become more accustomed to online buying, an increasing number of individuals are purchasing cell phones over the internet. In this paper, the price elasticity of mobile phones from Taobao is estimated using a logarithmic function model, and the link between price elasticity and market share, online sales, and pricing is empirically investigated. This study used data analytic to discover that as the price of a brand with a significant market share drops, the sales volume increases. In addition, this study examines elasticity changes caused by COVID-19 and shows practical implications with proposed business solutions; this study found that The price drop will affect the sales volume, and the sales volume will change with the price change. The findings will give helpful information to internet cell phone vendors.

articleTitle: Does Green Credit Policy Promote technological Innovation Capability?―Based on the Evidence of Regression Discontinuity Design
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Based on the Green Credit guidelines issued in 2012 as an example, this paper constructs a quasi-natural experiment to identify the causal relationship between green credit guidance policies and corporate innovation with the help of regression discontinuity design (RDD).
