The study found that around 2012, there is an obvious upward breakpoint in the number of patent applications of A-share listed companies in Shanghai and Shenzhen stock markets, and the implementation of green credit policy has promoted the innovation of enterprises as a whole. At the same time, this paper tests the robustness of the RDD estimation results by adding covariates and selecting different optimal bandwidth and kernel density functions, and the regression results are still significant at the 1 level.

articleTitle: Design and Applications of Historical and Cultural Blocks Spatial Database Based on GIS
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: With the rapid advancement of urbanization, urban development has shifted from incremental construction to stock improvement, and the protection of historical and cultural blocks with unique characteristics and values has received more and more attention. In the context of “smart city”, this paper collects historical and cultural blocks resource information and constructs spatial database to realize the intelligent organization, storage, identification, reasoning and visual display of big data in block. Taking Shiquan Chengguan historical and cultural block as the research object, using spatial analysis methods to achieve graphic display and information query, evaluation and classified protection, scoping and overall protection, providing a platform of technical support for the protection of historical and cultural blocks, and upgrading intelligent protection path.

articleTitle: Big data and supply chain digital transformation
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: As an important strategic production factor, big data enhances the visibility of enterprise operation, improves decision-making efficiency, and promotes the accuracy of product design. On the basis of combing the literature and high-frequency words analysis, this paper puts forward the digital transformation mode of traditional supply chain based on big data technology from the perspectives of strategic layer and operational level, to provide a reference for the research of supply chain digitization in the future.

articleTitle: Research and Exploration of College Student Award Management System Based on Information System Under the Background of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: University award management plays an important role in cultivating students ‘ good quality. However, at the present stage, most colleges and universities have scattered award management structures and generally use traditional manual means of information office. The shortcomings of low system efficiency, a high error rate and complex repetition have made students and faculty complain. In this paper, the current situation of the award management system for college students is investigated. In line with the characteristics of the big data era, the causes of the problems are analyzed in depth according to the phenomenon. Combined with the practical experience of the management of colleges and universities, the literature review method, research method and object-oriented method are used to analyze the significance of the construction of the system. A multi-parameter award management system is constructed and realized by using the management information system.

Author Keywords: Comprehensive Talent Training in Colleges and Universities

articleTitle: Application of Big Data Technology in Students’ Sports Risk Control
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: This paper mainly analyzes the application of big data technology in the risk control of student sports. Big data technology uses data mining and cluster analysis to carry out physical education teaching, training and management. Data analysis is one of the core functions of big data technology. It monitors students’ sports status through data and integrates sports data systematically. This paper analyzes the potential risks of students’ sports dynamically through the operation of data mining. Using big data technology to deal with the occurrence of students’ sports accidents, and take corresponding measures. With the advantages of big data technology, the risk degree of students’ sports activities will be finally reduced, a comprehensive sports risk system will be established, and the risk control system of school sports will be improved.

articleTitle: Research on enterprise financial Information systems under ERP environment — Based on data visualization method
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: In this paper, data visualization analysis method is used to deeply analyse the application of ERP system in Haier Group's financial system, find the problems existing in Haier Group's financial sharing centre and clarify the factors restricting Haier group's financial development at the present stage In order to further promote the development of Higher quality of Haier Group, reference suggestions are put forward, that is, organizational reform, optimization of financial system, improvement of assessment indicators, so as to establish a more professional financial management system to meet the requirements of the company's development In addition, this paper introduces in detail the advantages and disadvantages of Haier Group's financial sharing centre from four dimensions of advantages, disadvantages, opportunities and threats by using SWOT analysis tools Finally through the structural design, this paper found that the use of financial sharing centre is conducive to better development of enterprises.

Author Keywords: ERP system Financial sharing center The SWOT analysis method

articleTitle: Research on the green supply chain performance of agricultural products based on big data analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: The green supply chain performance of agricultural products in the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Yangtze River Delta, and Pearl River Delta regions is investigated in this study based on big data analysis. An evaluation indicator system was built using economy, supply chain, regional brand innovation, and environmental factors. The BCC model in data envelopment analysis (DEA) was used to secure final evaluations. These results show that the performance of agricultural products in the green supply chains of the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei urban agglomeration is better than in the Yangtze River Delta or Pearl River Delta urban agglomerations. Beijing, Hebei, Shanghai, Jiangsu, and Dongguan reach DEA efficiency while performance levels are relatively low in Tianjin, Zhejiang, Anhui, and Guangzhou; this is manifested in a mismatch between the input and output of production factors, low resource utilization rates, poor awareness of green production, over-consumption of agricultural products, imperfect infrastructures, and other problems.

articleTitle: Experimental study on the influence of abusive management on the job performance based on Internet technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Against the background of the COVID-19, the global economic situation is not optimistic. The Job performance of employees is the basis of corporate interests, and the choice of management style will directly affect employees' work mentality and behavior. Based on the survey data of 963 employees in high-tech enterprises across China, this paper uses the hierarchical regression method to explore the influence mechanism of abusive management (AS) on job performance (JP). Common method deviation (CMV) showed no obvious common method bias problem in the data collected in this study. The results showed that there was significant negative correlation between abusive management and job performance <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\beta=-0.023, \mathrm{p} < 0.05)$</tex>. The relationship between abusive management and job performance was partially mediated by job insecurity (JI). After adding job insecurity as mediating variable between AS and JP, the effect of abusive management on job performance changes from <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\beta=-0.042$</tex> (p<0.05) to <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\beta=-0.029$</tex> (p <0.05). The bootstrap method was also used in this study to test the mediating effect. Self-efficacy (SE) and job insecurity had significant interaction, and the coefficient is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\beta=-0.112(\mathrm{p} < 0.05)$</tex>. So, SE moderated the relationship between job insecurity and job performance.

articleTitle: Research on network attention of Wuxi 5A scenic spots based on Internet big data: Take Baidu Index as an example
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: In the context of information big data, we can understand the attention of tourists to scenic spots through network data. Consumers will use Baidu to search the information of relevant scenic spots, leave behavior data on Baidu platform, and form Baidu Index Based on the analysis of these massive user data. Through the big data analysis of Baidu Index of 5A scenic spots in Wuxi, the development trend, temporal and spatial characteristics and crowd structure characteristics of scenic spots' network attention are obtained. This paper finds the problems and opportunities existing in the development of Wuxi scenic spots, and puts forward effective strategies and suggestions from the perspective of marketing, hoping to further improve the popularity of Wuxi 5A scenic spots.

articleTitle: Rainbow options construction and evaluation based on big data analysis of stock indexes
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Contemporarily, the status and practicability of rainbow options are becoming important with the development of finance in the global market. To hedge the risk of investing in one underlying asset, investors obtain more stable profit through buying rainbow options. This paper selects two underlying assets-SSE50 Index and CNT index to evaluate the features of rainbow options based on Mento Carlo Simulation. According to the analysis, investors can hedge marketing risks and earn profits significantly through rainbow options. These results shed light on applying the rainbow option in the Chinese market.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Related M&A on Enterprise Performance: Based on the Method of Data Envelopment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: As China's macroeconomic growth has entered the “fast lane” and the sound capital market is gradually forming, mergers and acquisitions for enterprises to achieve diversification of business, risk sharing, improve the competitiveness of products in the market provides an important means. Based on this background, based on the information asymmetry theory, synergy theory and scale theory, based on using the data envelopment analysis and multiple regression method, from 2014 to 2018 in stock markets of Shanghai and Shenzhen listed company mergers and acquisitions(M&A) events as a sample data for empirical test, study whether M&A impacts on the acquisition of enterprise performance, and consider the size of the company in adjustment. The empirical results show that there is a significant positive correlation between related M&A and enterprise performance, and the cross term of related M&A and enterprise size is significantly negative correlated with enterprise performance, indicating that enterprise size has a weakening effect on the positive correlation between related M&A and enterprise performance.

articleTitle: Application blockchain in supply chain finance: a study on small and micro enterprises in Xi'an
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Blockchain has the characteristics of decentralization, traceability and non-tampering and is very suitable for the study of supply chain finance. In supply chain finance, blockchain can alleviate the information asymmetry between small and micro enterprises and commercial banks, and reduce the financing cost of enterprises. This paper takes small and micro enterprises in Xi'an as the research objects, and analyzes the influences of blockchain to supply chain finance. Based on the theories of blockchain and supply chain finance, this paper designs the supply chain financing mode based on blockchain. It is suggested that small and micro enterprises in Xi’ an should actively use blockchain technology to alleviate the financing dilemma.

articleTitle: Empirical Study of CAPM in the 5G sector of Chinese stock market
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: This paper aims to verify The Capital Asset Pricing Model (CAPM) in the Chinese 5G stock market. Daily information of nineteen 5G stocks was selected from the Shanghai Stock market from January 2019 to October 2021 for analysis. This paper tested the CAPM model using the Black, Jensen, and Scholes (BJS) time-series method and Fama and Macbeth (FM). The result shows lack of statistically significant evidence in CAPM verification on Chinese stock portfolio, and failed to prove the validity of CAPM in 5G stocks of the Chinese stock market. Reasons such as insufficient 5G companies information, unique Chinese stock market situation, and Chinese treasury bill require further research to adjust CAPM application to guide decision making for corporate and individual investors.

articleTitle: Modeling of the correlation between tourist cognitive behavior and safety accidents
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Since the Covid-19 pandemic was effectively controlled in China. Scenic visitors are also recovering quickly. Therefore, various tourism safety accidents occur in tourist destinations. Because of the occurrence of Covid-19 makes tourists more deeply aware of the importance of tourism safety. This paper will explore the important factors and mutual influence of tour guides in the process of group tour. Combining the experience of tour guides with the comprehensive scholars' research on tourism safety. Remind visitors of safety issues that are easy to ignore during tourism. Select ten travel emergencies from the perspective of experts and tour guides that including missing the tour group, changing travel plans, missing flights, lost property documents, lost tourists, sick passengers, traffic accidents, public security accidents, fire accidents, sports accidents. Evaluation of impact accidents using the DEMATEL method. It is looking for the cause or impact of safety accidents to remind tour guides to lead the tour to prevent the occurrence of safety accidents. The results of the study proved that changing travel plans, missing flights, missing the tour group three standards are the main causes of travel safety accidents.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Rural Talent Information Platform Under the Background of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Based on the cloud platform of large data sharing technology to break the existing talent information service platform, to the household registration data, education statistics, social security service data and other related data sharing, structures, data architecture, the focus on talent chain, industry chain, information chain combination data sharing mechanism, to build a one-stop talent data analysis engine, In view of the problems existing in the construction of information platform, such as low informatization efficiency of talent resource allocation and unsuitable talent training platform mode, this paper improves the data center layer and application layer of the platform, aiming to provide reference for the digital development and specific practice of rural talent revitalization in China.

articleTitle: An Empirical Analysis of the Satisfaction of College Innovation and Entrepreneurship Education Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: This paper selects students from colleges in Heilongjiang as the research object, and uses the Internet to issue questionnaires and collect data. On the basis of big data, SPSS analysis software is used to conduct an empirical analysis of satisfaction of innovation and entrepreneurship education. It is found that the overall satisfaction of innovation and entrepreneurship education in colleges is low. Finally, according to the calculation formula of priority, the item's priority for improvement is analyzed and the suggestions for improvement are put forward.

articleTitle: Research on the impact of audit failure on corporate performance based on multiple regression model: Take Kangmei Pharmaceutical as an example
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: With the continuous development of the economic market, corporate financial fraud causes financial risks and ultimately leads to audit failure. In enterprises, audit failure, financial risk, and corporate performance are closely linked. In view of what kind of impact audit failure will bring to enterprise performance, this paper mainly studies the pharmaceutical industry. Firstly, formulae are given to calculate enterprise performance, and then multiple regression models are established to analyze enterprise performance and main financial indicators and to judge the correlation between financial risk and enterprise performance. Then, KangMei Pharmaceutical, once the leader of the pharmaceutical industry, is represented to describe the relationship between the two. Finally, combined with industry data analysis and specific case analysis, suggestions are given for enterprises to strengthen internal control management and industries to strengthen supervision and law enforcement, in order to a provide reference for the subsequent face of related problems.

articleTitle: Analysis of the market demand of cold chain logistics based on big data research
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: In recent ten years, the demand of China's cold chain logistics market has risen sharply. Accurate analysis and prediction of cold chain logistics market demand is of great significance to optimize industry supply and improve market operation efficiency. Based on statistical data and vehicle operation big data, this paper analyzes the demand scale, demand structure and demand distribution of agricultural cold chain logistics market. Using grey model and multiple linear regression model, this paper selects 8 influencing factor indicators, calculates the correlation between each influencing factor and market demand, and forecasts the market demand of China's agricultural cold chain logistics. The results show that the demand of China's agricultural cold chain logistics market is affected by many factors such as production, consumption, society and industry, especially the output of main fresh agricultural products and the number of refrigerated vehicles have a significant positive impact on the demand of agricultural cold chain logistics market. Under the joint promotion of supply and demand, the demand of China's cold chain logistics market will still maintain a stable growth, the industry has broad development space. It is suggested to make simultaneous efforts from both ends of supply and demand, increase the effective supply of facilities and equipment, promote the connection between supply and demand, optimize the production and supply of fresh agricultural products, improve the cold chain circulation rate of fresh agricultural products such as fruits and vegetables, meet the social consumption demand and better promote the development of cold chain logistics.

articleTitle: Research on the influence mechanism of CEO academic background on enterprise value: Based on the fixed effect model in the context of big data
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Using the panel data of 2638 A-share listed companies in China from 2015 to 2020, this paper tests the mediating effect and moderating effect by using the fixed effect model, analyzes the impact of the academic background CEOs of listed companies on enterprise value and its mechanism, and discusses the masking effect. The results show that the academic background of CEOs of listed companies has a positive impact on enterprise value, and this impact is positively regulated by enterprise scale; The level of commercial credit financing is one of the mediating paths for the impact of CEO's academic background on enterprise value. CEO's academic background significantly improves the level of commercial credit financing, and excessive financing has a masking effect in the path of CEO's academic background affecting enterprise value

articleTitle: Application of Data Analysis in Warehouse Optimization and Customer Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: The development of the Internet has promoted the rapid development of e-commerce, and at the same time impacted the traditional retail industry, making it seek to combine data analysis, machine learning and other modern means to seek the advancement of new retail. This paper studied the two links of warehousing (belonging to supply chain) and customer purchasing behavior (belonging to consumers) in the business ecosystem, in order to put forward a feasible plan to reduce costs and improve sales profits. That was to optimize product storage in local warehouses and use customer segmentation to achieve precise marketing according to consumer consumption habits in different regions. More importantly, the role of data analysis (data statistics and data visualization analysis) and machine learning model (K-means) in the sustainable development of the retail industry was described in detail.

articleTitle: An evolutionary game analysis of the Credibility of Chinese family professional managers
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: With the promotion of the status of human capital, the cooperation between Chinese family enterprises and professional managers are becoming more and more important. However, there are problems such as information asymmetry, interest inconsistency, and imbalance between family enterprises and professional managers. In turn, these issues lead to moral hazards in partnerships. In this context, this paper uses the evolutionary game method to study whether professional managers and family enterprises operate in good faith and whether they supervise. The results show that compensation incentives and compensation for breach of trust are beneficial to reduce the dishonest management behavior of professional managers. However, in the long run, professional managers often choose to operate in bad faith to get extra profits. Because of this problem, family enterprises and professional managers need to formulate more effective measures to regulate.

articleTitle: Comparison of “Necessary” and “Netease Yanxuan” business models based on data analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: With the development of the information age, data has become an important information assets of enterprises. The large amount of data accumulated by enterprise management system has important commercial value. But for most enterprises, the utilization of data is still very low. How to maximize the value of enterprise data and guide enterprise decision-making is a problem that enterprises need to solve. Based on the data analysis, this paper makes a comparative analysis of the business models of Jiexicheng and Yanxuan, and puts forward optimization suggestions.

articleTitle: Empirical Study of Finance Distress Prediction Based on Accounting anomalies
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: This paper uses Logistic regression to establish a financial crisis warning model based on accounting anomalies indicators, financial indicators and non-financial indicators, it makes 224 companies listed on the Shanghai and Shenzhen Stock Exchanges as a research object from 2017 to 2019, including 112 companies in a special trade and that much in normal trade, and it tests the effectiveness of the warning model. The results show that the accounting anomalies indicators can effectively improve the predictive ability of the financial crisis warning model, and it has important reference value for investors to effectively identify financial crisis and government departments to strengthen the supervision of listed companies.

articleTitle: Data Analysis on the Influence of Chinese Traditional Culture on English-speaking Countries and Their Translation Based on the Corpus of COCA
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: In the times of big data, culture-loaded expressions are of great significance in the research of translation and cross-cultural communication. This paper makes use of big data to study a group of culture-loaded expressions related to “Lantern Festival”, which is a representative of Chinese traditional culture, retrieves the data about them in the largest free online English database of corpus “Corpus of Contemporary American English (COCA)”, and makes use of quantitative research method to analyze the data frequency of these expressions, hopefully to find out data about the influence of “Lantern Festival” on English-speaking world and more appropriate translation versions of these expressions, so as to deduce the influence of Chinese traditional cultures in these areas and the better way of translating these expressions, and to meet the needs of the era of big data.

articleTitle: Evaluation Model Construction and Algorithm Design of Leader Team Performance Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Performance evaluation of leader team can provide information support for organizations to collect, analyze, evaluate and transmit behaviors and work outcomes of the team, which makes the team be more compatible with organizational strategy. Based on the literature review, this study proposed a performance evaluation model for the leader team and designed its solution algorithm based on the idea of data mining. Taking the annual performance evaluation of leader team in a large state-owned power company's subsidiary as a case, this study verified the effectiveness of the algorithm and provides decision support for team development and organizational assessment.

articleTitle: Research on E-commerce Precision Marketing Model Based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: With the development of information technology and the popularization of the Internet, people's lifestyles have undergone tremendous changes. The e-commerce industry continues to grow with the development of the Internet. China's e-commerce industry has grown rapidly in recent years, and the competition among e-commerce companies has become increasingly fierce. Big data technology has also been frequently used in the management of e-commerce companies recently. Big data technology can analyze user purchasing habits, consumption records and other data collected by the terminal through cloud computing, unstructured data, and Hadoop, and outline user portraits, providing a large amount of data foundation for e-commerce companies to carry out precision marketing, and improve Marketing success rate.

articleTitle: Evolutionary Game Analysis and Simulation of Government Regulation and Enterprise Pollution Control Behavior
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: In the game of environmental governance, the strategic choice of government and enterprises affects the effect of environmental governance. This paper constructs an asymmetric evolutionary game model between the two subjects of “government-enterprise,” analyzes the strategy evolution path of each game subject and the factors affecting its strategy evolution by using the stability theorem of the differential equation, and discusses the evolutionary stability strategy of the system through the Jacobian matrix. In the numerical simulation part, the paper analyzes the interactive evolution path of the government and polluting enterprises in environmental governance, and simulates the impact of government punishment, enterprise pollution control cost, government reward and enterprise pollution control income on the system evolution and stability strategy when the government punishment is greater than the regulation cost. The study shows that the improvement of government rewards, enterprise pollution control income and government punishment can promote enterprises to strive to control environmental pollution. Government rewards can replace the government's regulation efforts. The higher the pollution control cost, the greater the opportunistic tendency of enterprises.

articleTitle: Bert-based Knowledge Graph Completion Algorithm for Few-Shot
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Knowledge graphs have shown increasing value in semantic search, intelligent Q&A, data analysis, natural language processing, visual understanding, IoT devices, etc. It is undeniable that knowledge graphs have become the mandatory path for the artificial intelligence fields development. However, the information contained in existing knowledge graphs is incomplete, which attracts a large number of researchers to enhance the completeness of knowledge graphs utilizing knowledge graph completion methods. Most traditional embedding-based knowledge graph completion models use structural information within data-rich triples from the knowledge graph is limited by the long-tail distribution of the relations in the triples. To address this problem, we propose a Bert-based knowledge graph completion algorithm for few-shot knowledge graphs, with the main goal of implementing the knowledge graph completion task with only a few sample triples of training instances. We improve the baseline model GMatching for handling few-shot knowledge graphs by introducing the Bert pre-trained linguistic representation model to enhance the semantic representation of entities and relations in the triples. Through experiments, we demonstrate that our improved model B-GMatching achieves good results.

articleTitle: Research on digital collaborative management model of engineering projects based on BIM and IPD
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: With the rapid development of the global economy and the continuous improvement of the economic system, engineering projects have become more market-oriented, the costs of engineering materials and construction machinery continue to rise, and the country advocates the concept of green building, which has put forward new requirements for engineering management. How to improve efficiency, the quality of project management and the management of information are all issues that need to be addressed urgently. With the gradual evolution of the delivery model of construction projects, the poor synergy between the various parties involved in the project under the traditional management model has led to poor project construction efficiency, which is increasingly unable to meet the needs of the industry. As a result, the project management concept under the traditional management mode has been backward, the degree of informatization is low and the collaboration and sharing is poor, which brings a lot of inconvenience to the project management. The emergence and rapid development of Building Information Modelling (BIM) can facilitate the work of project decision-makers and participants in information management and collaborative management. BIM technology is a modern information technology platform that enables the creation and use of parametric models for the design, construction and operation management of construction projects. It also allows for collaborative management between the customer, implementation and operation parties to achieve life-cycle management of the project. The introduction of the IPD (Integrated Project Delivery) collaborative management model, based on trust and supported by BIM technology, has not only transformed the project management model, but has also brought about a revolutionary change in project management by improving collaboration between project participants.

articleTitle: A Framework of Value Connection Route for Fresh Agri-product E-commerce: A Grounded Theory Approach in the Context of China
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: While the traditional business model is difficult to make a real-time response to the market dynamics, fresh agri-products E-commerce (FAP e-commerce) needs a unique operation model. This paper focuses on the value connection route of FAP e-commerce and develops the framework of a sustainable business model which connects suppliers with the customers. Based on grounded theory, the research takes the community lead-warehouse of MeiRiYouXian as the case background to analyze the value connection route from the product and service to the user behavior. Practical implications are drawn from the case study for firms to achieve sustainability through business model innovation in FAP e-commerce field, and for the government to support the F AP e-commerce to achieve sustainable development.

articleTitle: Research on Informatization-oriented Teaching Reform Regarding Major of Accounting in Higher Vocational Education in the Background of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: With the rapid development of the modern science and technology, the society has gradually entered the era of big data, which can brings both opportunities and challenges for the education and teaching of the accounting major in colleges and universities. And the reform and innovation of informatization of the accounting major are imminent. In this paper, in the background of big data era, we put forward the reform ways of the current informationalized teaching of the accounting majors in higher education institutions from the aspects of the curriculum system, personnel training objectives, teaching team, correspongding resources and modes as well as teaching evaluation system, which can be the reference for the transformation of the accounting major and the training of informationalized talents.

articleTitle: Blackhole -A flying paddle algorithm platform and its actual application to quantify the financial sklearn framework
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: The first few years of the 21st century seem to show the extraordinary nature of this century to mankind. Looking back, our industrial and economic development currently has gone far beyond that of the second industrial revolution and is approaching a new cycle. But in the first two decades of the new century, what we have done are actually brewing some innovative technological forces. In the field of information technology, either machine learning or meta-universe, new fields have emerged as an indication that the next technological revolution in computer technology is under way. In contrast, the way the economy evolves is somewhat not in step with the development of today's social advances. In the age of consecutive upgrading in digital technology, what should we do to strike gold in the financial world of the future? The possibilities are diverse. In this connection, this paper cites automatic quantitative and migration learning modeling in the hope that it will provide others with some material points for discussion and critique or a possible reference for thinking.

articleTitle: Digitalization, Cultural Capital and Productivity: Evidence From Resource-based Enterprises in China
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: With the development of big data, artificial intelligence, and other technologies, digitalization has become an important means for resource-based enterprises to cope with technology and market shocks. Based on social embeddedness theory and cultural capital theory, this article used the data of resource-based listed companies in China from 2014 to 2018, to explore the relationship between digitalization, cultural capital, and the productivity of resource-based enterprises. The findings show that digitalization has a significant role in promoting the productivity of resource-based enterprises, and regional cultural capital has a positive moderating effect on the relationship between digitalization and productivity. The results indicate that the higher regional cultural capital plays an important role in promoting digitalization and enhancing the productivity of resource-based enterprises, which will provide practical guidance for balancing the regional differences of resource-based enterprises' digital transformation.

articleTitle: The influence of the characteristics of Internet celebrities on consumers' impulsive buying behavior in the big data economy: Empirical test based on multiple linear regression model
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: With the promotion of national big data policies and the development of big data technologies, traditional business models are being rewritten and entrepreneurial opportunities in big data-related fields are emerging in large numbers. web celebrity anchors have many characteristics. They can influence consumers' impulsive buying behavior through their own personality on internet, characteristics and the relationship between consumers and other characteristics. Many research results mainly focus on the web celebrity marketing mode, advantages and disadvantages, marketing strategies and the impact on consumers' purchase intention, etc., but the impact on consumers' impulsive purchase behavior is rare. The development of network technology has broken the boundaries of time and space, based on SOR theory model and big data, this paper takes consumer sentiment as a mediating variable to study the impact of personal traits of web celebrity on consumers' impulsive buying behavior. The independent variables are divided into three dimensions, including personal charm, professionalism and relationship strength. Through the literature collation and research, the maturity scale was used to compile the questionnaire. Analyzing the results of questionnaire survey, we find that personal charm and relationship strength have a positive effect on consumers' impulsive buying behavior. Consumer emotion has a positive effect on consumers' impulsive buying behavior. As an intermediary, consumers' emotions play a role between independent variables and dependent variables. This study expands the theoretical research on web celebrity characteristics and constructs a mediation model, which has certain practical significance for the study of impulsive buying behavior of consumers.

articleTitle: The impact of US carbon tariff policy on China's social welfare and industrial development under the background of economic globalization—Based on big data empirical research
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Regarding the tension of carbon tariff between the United States and China, I establish a sequential game model to derive a relationship between the carbon tariff rate, export quantity and the social welfare for the developed country and developing country. To quantify the impact of the carbon tariff, I adopt time series analysis to empirically test the China-US tariff-export effect. The Granger causality test shows that the increase in Chinese export quantity is the cause for the United States increase in tariff rate in the long run, but not the opposite way. The Co-integration Analysis and Error Correction Model also predict that the implementation of the carbon tariff is negatively correlated with Chinese social welfare in the short run dynamically, and it will severely decrease the revenue of carbon-intensive industries. Taking environmental influence into account, I advance my model to include stages for the developing country's government to provide a carbon subsidy and firms to innovate low-carbon emission technology. In this sequential game, I derive the condition for developing countries to impose a carbon tariff and the impact of carbon tariff on the environment. Since carbon tariffs may be avoided and ineffective in the long run, I also develop a model of both countries producing a carbon-intensive good together by combining their technology or labor, and Shapley value gives an optimal proportion of the production percentage for each country. For China, it is necessary to develop environmentally-friendly technology as soon as possible. As Stern Review and Nordhaus suggested, the tradable carbon market, carbon tax and industrial policy are all potential methods for the government to improve social welfare and decrease pollution. The role of the carbon tariff could be viewed as an incentive to force the developing countries to break their inertia. Then, in the long run, cooperation can be mutually beneficial for countries to get out of the prisoner dilemma and share their specialized factors of production.

articleTitle: A method for testing the feasibility of 3D map design based on multi-agent AI-driven
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: As one of the most cutting-edge technologies of graphics and multimedia, the core of the three-dimensional map is the spatial layout design of the virtual world. The three-dimensional digital map has significant spatial design significance. It uses a method consistent with geographic theory to integrate the real and the fiction and attach it to various applications such as factory layout, workshop layout, production line planning, and so on. Therefore, the three-dimensional digital map as the spatial background of production and operation to carry various resources is an important part of digital design. Among them, ensuring that the virtual avatar representing a real person can move in an open and feasible space and reach the expected endpoint is an important content of three-dimensional map path planning. To solve the problem of 3D map design level testing, this paper proposes an automated testing method driven by ai multi-agents, which simulates three typical human behaviors and conducts automatic, fast, and comprehensive testing of 3D maps to evaluate the level of 3D map design.

articleTitle: Multi-level Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation of Automated Terminal Equipment Effectiveness Based on Covariance-Analytic
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Aiming at many factors affecting the configuration and effectiveness of the automated terminal equipment, a multi-level fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model based on the covariance-analytic method is adopted to evaluate the effectiveness of automated terminal equipment. From the four aspects of terminal equipment effectiveness, capacity, cost, and reliability, we build an automated terminal efficiency evaluation index system and effectiveness evaluation model. For the determination of quantitative and qualitative indicators, the covariance-analysis method is used to determine the index weights. And the multi-level fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method is used to evaluate the impact of automated terminal equipment resources on the effectiveness of automated terminals. The evaluation results show that the cost of automated terminal equipment is a key factor affecting the effectiveness of automated terminals. And the optimization of the resource allocation of automated terminal equipment is an important way to improve the effectiveness of terminal equipment.

articleTitle: Research on Street Space Quality Combined with Attention Multi-Task Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: In the context of advocating human-oriented urbanism, in order to more accurately evaluate the urban scene. This paper uses the sentiment evaluation of millions of street view images in the Place Pulse 2.0 data set to design a multi-task deep learning network (Mtl-attn-vgg) fused with attention to analyze the urban spatial quality attributes. Multi-task learning is used to simultaneously learn different attributes and the attention mechanism to focus on the characteristics of the object to improve the effect of the convolutional layer on the attribute feature extraction, combined with deep relative attribute learning, use the structural sparsity of the feature matrix to compare the attribute features In addition, classification loss and ranking loss are introduced to constrain the parameters of the deep learning network. Finally, six attributes of street view are beautiful, boring, depressed, lively, safe, and rich. The results show that the Mtl-attn-vgg model improves the feature extraction effect and improves the accuracy of attribute sorting to 78.48%, which is more conducive to urban designers and planners to understand the attribute characteristics of the street scene environment.

articleTitle: Impacts of consumer market search behavior on retailers' decision-making: a CVaR analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: In recent years, the impact of human behavioral issues on the supply chain decision making is to arouse higher attention, such as risk attitude and so on. Behavioral factors, such as risk aversion, can directly influence a manager's procurement decisions. In this paper, we focus on the impact of a retailer's risk aversion on its decision making considering the consumer market search behavior. We use the CVaR to evaluate retailer's risk preference and select a single product supply chain system, which consists of one manufacturer and two retailers. By the theoretical analysis, we find that the customer market search behavior can promote the retailers' order quantity, for there is probability that retailers are in short supply. At the same time, the risk-averse attitude will make the retailer tend to conservative. So the retailer with risk aversion should make a trade-off and we explore the bilateral influence of risk attitude and shortage penalty.

articleTitle: Research on Problems and Countermeasures of Third-Party Evaluation in Chinese Government Performance Evaluation Based on Interpretative Structural Equation Model
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: At present, my country is still in the initial exploration stage in the practice of third-party evaluation of government performance. This article explores the practical process of third-party evaluation of government performance in my country, and analyzes the current difficulties faced by third-party government performance evaluation in my country, such as lack of legal protection and information communication mechanisms. There are many issues such as the application of evaluation results. It also attempts to quantitatively analyze the internal mechanism of interaction between different constraints from the interpretative structural modeling (ISM). To establish and improve the third-party evaluation system, one can try from legislative guarantees, information disclosure, third-party independence, etc., so as to effectively establish and implement a third-party government performance evaluation mechanism, and correctly handle government and third-party institutions (such as social The relationship between the public and intermediary evaluation agencies and other subjects) promotes the healthy development of my country’ s third-party government performance evaluation.

articleTitle: Preface
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM)
abstract: Due to the prevention and control of COVID-19 and travel restrictions worldwide, 2021 2nd International Conference on Big Data Economy and Information Management (BDEIM 2021) was adjusted to online (video) Conference. BDEIM 2021 was organized by AEIC Academic Exchange Information Center. It dedicated to create a platform for academic communications between specialists and scholars in the fields of Big Data Economy and Information Management. The conference created a path to establish a research relation for the authors and listeners with opportunities for collaboration and networking among the universities and institutions for promoting research and developing technologies. The conference model was divided into three sessions, including oral presentations, keynote speeches, and online Q&A discussion. In the first part, some scholars, whose submissions were selected as the excellent papers, were given about 5-10 minutes to perform their oral presentations one by one. Then in the second part, keynote speakers were each allocated 30-45 minutes to hold their speeches. There were 190 individuals who attended this on-line conference, represented many countries including Canada, Malaysia, Australia, USA and India. In the second part, we invited five professors as our keynote speakers. Assoc. Prof. Chaohui Zhang, Jilin University, China. His main research fields include quantitative economics, e-commerce, and data mining. And then we had Prof. Runhui Lin, Nankai University, China. His research focuses on network organizations and governance, corporate governance of Chinese MNCs, technology (ICT) and innovation management, system analysis of complex organization systems and management systems, and network analysis methodology. Assoc. Prof. Daisy Kee Mui Hung, Universiti Sains Malaysia, Malaysia. Her areas of interests are in Human Resource Management, Organizational Behavior, Work Values, Leadership, Entrepreneurship, and Psychosocial safety climate. Prof. Dongzi Zheng, Shanghai University of International Business and Economics, China. His research fields include the leisure and Tourism Scenic Area Management. Lastly, we were glad to invite Prof. Wenbing Zhao, Cleveland State University, USA. Their insightful speeches had triggered heated discussion in the third session of the conference. Every participant praised this conference for disseminating useful and insightful knowledge. The proceedings are a compilation of the accepted papers and represent an interesting outcome of the conference. Topics include but are not limited to the following areas: Big Data Economy, Information Management and other related topics. All the papers have been through rigorous review and process to meet the requirements of international publication standard. We sincerely hope that the BDEIM 2021 turned out to be a forum for excellent discussions that enabled new ideas to come about, promoting collaborative research. We are sure that the proceedings will serve as an important research source of references and knowledge, which will lead to not only scientific and engineering findings but also new products and technologies.
